title: update Maintainers and Governance to link to community repo
body: With the new community repo we use that as place to define our Governance and the org wide rules. As such we should just link there to avoid duplication and drift.

comments.body: @TomSweeneyRedHat I await you proposed changes on podman as PR, then I copy the same wording to all the other open PRs I have for all other repos.
